confidence_notes: Restaurant and beer anchors rest on crowd-sourced or aggregated 2025-2026 data from Expatistan, MyLifeElsewhere, CityCost, Toast and Pricelisto, with small samples. Cocktail is a judgement from one venue, a 2019 study and a generic guide. Cappuccino is inferred from the Toast median for regular coffee (2025). Wine by the glass has no direct San Diego data and is derived from the local beer price. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for a July peak-season window and were not checked against live listings. FX is weaker than required: the RBA exchange-rates page was surfaced by search but not read live, and the only RBA value seen was a snippet dated 2026-03-20, roughly seven months before the generation date, so it is not the latest observation and should be verified on rba.gov.au before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was needed; the anchors are based on San Diego, California, US-level pricing and local aggregated price indexes. The wine_glass anchor uses a local restaurant wine-to-beer price relationship of about 1.5x, because no direct glass price was found.
